name: Multiplicative Interaction Module
aliases: Multiplicative Interaction Module (MI-NeRF conditional input module)
definition: A neural module that generates conditional inputs for a NeRF by computing multiplicative interactions between expression, identity, and optional latent codes to improve facial disentanglement and rendering quality.
summary: The Multiplicative Interaction Module generates NeRF inputs by modeling second- and third-order multiplicative dependencies between semantic codes, unlike linear concatenation.
